title: On Vortex Atoms
container-title: Proceedings of the Royal Society of Edinburgh
note: Read February 18, 1867 (Proc. Roy. Soc. Edinburgh 6, session 1866-1869, pp. 94-105); reprinted in Philosophical Magazine (4) 34 (1867), 15-24. William Thomson (Lord Kelvin) proposes that elementary atoms are knotted and linked vortex rings in a ubiquitous medium.
